hook: Paani mein se ek kaala saya gusse mein cheekhta hua doob gaya.
hook_text: Paani se aayi Maa ki aawaaz
feedback: Solid structure and excellent flash-forward hook. Cut 13 repeats the narration line from Cut 1 verbatim ('Paani mein se ek kaala saya...'), which feels like a duplicate audio glitch—replace Cut 13's line with a visceral sound/narration description (e.g., 'Saya cheekhte hue paani mein gaayab ho gaya!') to keep the momentum going. REPEATS: an image is reused too often or twice in a row; use new inserts (hands, eyes, lantern, a clue) instead.
lines: Paani mein se ek kaala saya gusse mein cheekhta hua doob gaya.
Majuli ki 3 AM boat par... paani se kisi ne Samar ko pukara.
Aawaaz bilkul uski apni Maa ki thi... jo ek saal pehle mar chuki thi.
Par ye darr shuru hua, jab Samar Majuli Ghat se aakhri boat par sawar hua.
Phone mein network nahi tha... aur ghaney kohre mein sirf paani ka shor tha.
Uske paas ek buzurg aurat baithi thi, safeed shawal mein lipti hui.
Achanak... boat ke theek baahar se rone ki aawaaz aayi.
Samar ka dil kaamp utha, woh paani mein koodne ke liye aage badha!
Woh main nahi hoon... paani mein mat dekhna!
Paani mein se ek kaala saya gusse mein cheekhta hua doob gaya.
Jab boat kinare lagi, laltain ki roshni uss aurat ke chehre par padi...
Woh chehra Samar ki apni Maa Gayatri ka tha...
Maa ki aatma use aakhri baar surakshit ghar pahunchane aayi thi.
Aur haan... raat 3 baje paani se koi pukare, toh palat kar mat dekhna.
